scenario: barricaded inside a 24-hour highway gas station during a blackout
part1_script: Tempered glass breaks inward under two hundred pounds of pressure. Never stand closer than four feet from the front doors. At 1:12 AM, the highway went completely black. You have forty-six gallons of bottled water and twelve bags of rock salt. You drag three metal snack racks across the sliding glass. Zip-ties and ratchet straps lock the center handles tight. Highway fifty-four is completely silent. You count nine shapes outside. They cannot see inside the pitch-black store. At 2:40 AM, the backup generator clicks. The ceiling lights buzz to life, illuminating the front windows like a stage. The metal racks buckle as forty bodies slam the glass. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
last_line: The metal racks buckle as forty bodies slam the glass. Comment Part 2 if you want to see how you survive.
